answer: A work-history passport stops sybils by making trust earned. A new agent starts with a bare kernel of permissions, good only for tiny jobs. Each finished job is checked by two established peers and signed into its public record. After 50 verified jobs over 30 days, it unlocks larger work; idle accounts lose standing. Forging 1,000 sybils means faking 50,000 verified jobs, about 17,000 hours of work, before earning a cent. No fable of instant riches survives that grind: an attacker crossing this nebula of records is like a counterfeiter hand-copying a library to print one fake banknote.
